answer: An attacker running 56 aliases as a result needs 61 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in velvet, expire in ridge, and island lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1434 identities would post 3725 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
